title: Both waiting for the other one to say it
old_caption: Typing, deleting, sending "hey :)" while they do the exact same thing. You're both holding the same door. Someone has to go first, and it can be you.

title: When they say "I don't know"
old_caption: You finally asked and heard "idk." Thank them for being honest. "I don't know" is an answer for now, so get clear on what you need and say it kindly.

title: Hearing "just friends" with grace
old_caption: Asked, and heard "just friends." It's okay if that hurts. A kind no is still a clear one, and "thank you for telling me" keeps the friendship whole.

title: Six months of almost
old_caption: Six months of umbrellas, second coffees and almost-asks interrupted by a waiter, a sneeze and a bus. Wait for the answer. Guessing took months, asking took a minute.

title: The holiday party plus-one
old_caption: The invite says +1 and your mind throws three imaginary parties. Keep the ask to two lines: what you want, and a question. Ask before the party, not at the door.

title: The talk, from both sides
old_caption: Two apartments, two pillows, the same fear and the same rehearsed words. If you're scared to ask, they might be too. Your almost is their almost.

title: When the answer is no
old_caption: Virgo asks, Leo says no, honestly and kindly. Then a sad weekend, a friend with soup, and a dinner full of laughing. A clear no gives you your weekends back.

title: Pisces finally asks
old_caption: Thirty-seven tissues and three almost-asks later, Pisces says it plainly. Bring tissues for the answer. Ask first, cry after, happy tears included.

title: Date 1 with a Fire sign: what to ask
old_caption: First dates feel like interviews when every question is about plans and jobs. With a fire sign, ask what excites them right now, then really listen. Save this for date one.

title: Date 2 with a Fire sign: reading it
old_caption: Second-date nerves love counting reply times. Look at effort instead: did they plan something, and did they talk you up? Fire signs show interest out loud.
